title: RFC 8747 cnf claim - DERIVED, not verbatim
description: DERIVED. RFC 8747 ships no JSON Schema - measured, zero occurrences of the string. This is the library's rendering of section 3.1's Table 1 and the prose around it, over a JSON projection of the CBOR map in which an integer confirmation key becomes its decimal string and a CBOR byte string becomes lowercase hex. The projection is lossy and is declared here rather than implied: CBOR distinguishes integer key 1 from text key "1" and JSON cannot, so this schema cannot express RFC 8747's key space and the CDDL beside it is normative for this extraction.

3.description: kid, a binary string rendered as lowercase hex - rfc-8747#R-0035

$comment: The `not`/`required` pair is the whole point of this file: it is the only construct here that binds, and it encodes rfc-8747#R-0029 - at most one of COSE_Key and Encrypted_COSE_Key may be present. Additional properties are allowed deliberately, because rfc-8747#R-0025 requires that unknown confirmation members be ignored rather than rejected. The empty object is valid because rfc-8747#R-0023 puts the required member set outside this document's scope.
